_comment: Observed cost of acquiring each source from nothing, recorded from the P1 run logs.
Committed because a re-derive from retained local data is fast and says nothing about
what this pipeline costs someone starting with an empty disk. reports/ingest.md renders
both: the measured cost of the current run (cached or network, labelled) and this, the
first-acquisition cost. Neither is presented as the other.

cve_list.detail: blobless partial clone + checkout of the pinned commit + full record scan
cve_list.transfer: git clone, 4.06 GiB on disk after checkout

nvd.detail: 198 paged API requests under the public rate limit (5 req / rolling 30s, 6s sleep), across resumable foreground runs

cwe.detail: one versioned zip download plus XML parse
